无论苏笑笑如何追问，郑多公都只是摇头，要么避而不答，要么就是反复强调杨瑞是好人，让他们不要招惹杨瑞，也不肯透露半句关于自己如何来到这里。

他的神色始终平静，却带着一丝不容置喙的坚定，仿佛一旦下定决心，就绝不会改变。

胡九郎和杨童对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了疑惑与凝重。

郑多公的反应太过反常，他显然是知道些什么，却刻意隐瞒，而且对杨瑞有着一种莫名的信任与敬畏，这绝非是被简单迷惑那么简单。

杨童轻声说道:

“郑先生，我们知道你有难言之隐，但这座古镇真的很诡异，杨瑞的真实身份不明，邪教的阴谋也还没有揭开，你留在这里未必真的安全。还请你再好好考虑一下，和我们一起离开。”

郑多公摇了摇头，站起身来，语气平淡地说道：

“不必了，我心意已决，不会离开这里的。你们也不要再劝我了，我还有些私事要处理，就不陪你们了。”

郑多公不等苏笑笑再开口，便转身走进了小院，关上了院门，苏笑笑看着紧闭的院门，眼中满是失落与焦急，想要上前敲门，却被胡九郎拉住。

胡九郎语气凝重地说道：

“别敲了，他心意已决，就算我们再追问，也问不出什么来。他显然是被杨瑞用某种手段控制住了，要么是被洗脑，要么是有什么把柄在杨瑞手里，再逼问下去，反而会打草惊蛇。”

杨童也点了点头、

“没错，现在我们问不出任何线索，继续留在这里也没有意义，不如先回去和余元山他们汇合，把这里的情况告诉他们，一起分析分析，再做打算。”

苏笑笑咬了咬嘴唇，心中满是不甘，却也知道，胡九郎和杨童说得对，继续留在这里，确实没有任何意义。

她低声说道：

“师叔，我不会放弃你的，我一定会查明真相，带你离开这里。”

三人沿着原路返回，一路上三人都沉默不语，心中满是疑惑。

郑多公的闪烁其词，对杨瑞的莫名信任，都让他们更加确定，这座古镇藏着不为人知的秘密。

他们不知道的是，在他们转身离开后，小院的门悄悄打开了一条缝隙，郑多公站在门后，望着他们离去的背影，眼中闪过一丝复杂的神色，有愧疚，有无奈，还有一丝不易察觉的恐惧，随后，他轻轻关上院门，身影消失在小院之中。

胡九郎三人沿着青石板路，返回余元山等人居住的宅院，只见余元山、李二牛、范梦雪、杨树远四人正坐在院中，神色凝重地低声交谈着，看到三人回来，立刻停下了交谈，纷纷看了过来。

“怎么样？找到郑先生了吗？有没有什么线索？”

余元山率先开口，语气急切地问道。

苏笑笑摇了摇头，脸上满是失落。

“找是找到了，但是师叔他什么都不肯说，只是说他是自愿留在这里的，还说杨瑞是个好人，让我们不要招惹杨瑞，不要和他起冲突。无论我怎么追问，他都避而不答，最后还找借口躲进了小院，不肯再见我们。”

No matter how Su Xiaoxiao asked, Zheng Duogong just shook his head and either avoided answering, or repeatedly emphasized that Yang Rui was a good person and told them not to provoke Yang Rui, and refused to reveal a word about how he got here.

His expression was always calm, but with a trace of unquestionable determination, as if once he made up his mind, he would never change.

Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong looked at each other, and both saw doubts and solemnity in each other's eyes.

Zheng Duogong's reaction was too abnormal. He obviously knew something but deliberately concealed it. He also had an inexplicable trust and respect for Yang Rui. This was by no means as simple as being deceived.

Yang Tong said softly:

"Mr. Zheng, we know you have something to hide, but this ancient town is really weird. Yang Rui's true identity is unknown, and the cult's conspiracy has not yet been revealed. It may not be really safe for you to stay here. Please think again and leave with us."

Zheng Duogong shook his head, stood up, and said calmly:

"No need, I have made up my mind and will not leave here. Don't try to persuade me anymore. I still have some personal matters to deal with, so I won't accompany you."

Zheng Duogong didn't wait for Su Xiaoxiao to speak again, then turned around and walked into the small courtyard and closed the door. Su Xiaoxiao looked at the closed door, her eyes full of loss and anxiety. She wanted to knock on the door, but was stopped by Hu Jiulang.

Hu Jiulang said in a solemn tone:

"Stop knocking. He has made up his mind. Even if we ask further, we won't be able to find out anything. He is obviously controlled by Yang Rui in some way. He is either brainwashed or has something in Yang Rui's hands. If we continue to press, he will be alerted."

Yang Tong also nodded,

"That's right. Now that we can't find any clues, there's no point in staying here. Why don't we go back and meet Yu Yuanshan and the others first, tell them the situation here, analyze it together, and then make a plan."

Su Xiaoxiao bit her lip, her heart full of reluctance, but she also knew that Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong were right, there was really no point in staying here.

She whispered:

"Uncle Master, I will not give up on you. I will definitely find out the truth and take you out of here."

The three of them returned along the original path, and all three of them were silent along the way, full of doubts in their hearts.

Zheng Duogong's evasive words and inexplicable trust in Yang Rui made them more certain that this ancient town hides unknown secrets.

What they didn't know was that after they turned and left, the door of the small courtyard quietly opened a crack. Zheng Duogong stood behind the door, watching their leaving figures, with a complicated look in his eyes, including guilt, helplessness, and a hint of subtle fear. Then, he gently closed the door and disappeared into the small courtyard.

Hu Jiulang and the others walked along the bluestone road back to the house where Yu Yuanshan and others lived. They saw Yu Yuanshan, Li Erniu, Fan Mengxue, and Yang Shuyuan sitting in the courtyard, talking solemnly in a low voice. When they saw the three people coming back, they immediately stopped talking and looked over.

"How's it going? Have you found Mr. Zheng? Are there any clues?"

Yu Yuanshan was the first to speak, asking in an urgent tone.

Su Xiaoxiao shook her head, her face full of disappointment.

"I found him, but my uncle refused to say anything. He just said that he stayed here voluntarily. He also said that Yang Rui is a good person and asked us not to provoke Yang Rui or conflict with him. No matter how I asked, he avoided answering. In the end, he made excuses to hide in the courtyard and refused to see us again."
